column7: Checks whether the appropriate normal-map texture handle is non-null depending on aBoolean3458 (a '3D/single-texture vs. 2D-array-of-16-slices' capability flag set in the constructor): returns `anInterface18_Impl3Array3459 != null` when false, else `anInterface18_Impl1_3452 != null`. `decoyThreshold < 81` nulls anInterface18_Impl1_3452 as a side effect.

Lazily builds `anInterface18_Impl1_3455`, a 16x128x128 normal-map texture computed from a heightfield via Sobel-style finite differences (dx/dy from neighbouring texels, normalized by `128/sqrt(dx^2+dy^2+128^2)`), packing (nx,ny,nz,height) into 4 bytes per texel, then uploads it via aHa_Sub3_3457.method3872. Clear normal-map-from-heightmap generation routine.
